alcohol_d: You drank some alcohol. You feel warm inside.
You drank lots of alcohol. Are those white mice?
You drank unholy amounts of alcohol. But what do you care?
You embalmed yourself alive with so much alcohol, that even undead will leave your dead body alone.
bssel: Ack! There's dust and cobweb everywhere in this place
Spiderweb lands on your face as you enter
Various broken garbage is littered around
You step on some glass shards and crush them
bsseldark: Ack! Something touches you from the darkness
You step in and something crunches underneath
You feel like something moved in front of you
You touched cobweb and felt gross
catasound: Your feet sink into the muddy ground
Damp stagnant air of the underground makes it difficult to breathe
You notice something move in the darkness
Aged walls have something written on them, but you are unable to decipher what it is
Bone bits are littered on the ground
Old rotting cloth is hanging from the walls
old stale air fills your lungs
fplcextra: You'll need fire if you want to get some cooking done
You can warm up here if you light it up
frplcfrextra: You notice the fire flickering slightly
Tiny fire is warming up the room
Comfy fire lights up the surroundings
Bright flame is roaring inside the Fireplace
hmcttt: Your cat comes out to greet you!
mbrdtt: "If you do not work your hours daily, you will not get any dessert"
"Do your job well and you will be rewarded"
There is a report of a missing cat
There is a section of useless gossip

This is an advertisement for hemp clothing

mscbkatxt: This fairy tale is about a wolf who eats so much salted meat she becomes trapped in the butcher's cellar.
In this traditional story of beastly intrigue a clever fox convinces an elderly lion to kill a derogatory wolf.
This is an illustrated fairy tale book about a conversation between a mouse and a cat.
An amusing collection of stories featuring a Thunder God on the cover.
This is a well illustrated fairy tale about a war between the birds and the beasts, with particulars on the wartime conduct and eventual fate of the bat.
This book, titled "The Rattlesnake's Vengeance" is a collection of local myths and legends.
This fairy tale book is a regional variant of a tale of friendship between the Demon and the Angel
This fairy tale book is entitled "Little Red Cap".  It details a red-cloaked child's various encounters with talking wolves.
A collection of ghost stories warning about the dangers of stealing from the dead.
A book of culinary fairy tales.  The cover features an orange fairy juggling a lemon, a lime, and a tangerine slimes.
A book of fables about people who change into birds.
This compendium of amusing folk tales about the devil is titled "Hell's Kettle: Legends of the Devil."
This charming book of fables is titled, "The Crystal Mountain and the Princess."
This is a collection of fairy tale stories warning against the consequences of extreme greed.
In this fairy tale a strong man frightens an ogre by squeezing water out of a stone.
This book of rustic folk tales bears the title: "How to Shout Down the Devil."
The title of this book is "Village Folk-tales of Darion."  It includes fables about logical errors and foolish misjudgements of the village men.
This book of folk tales is titled, "The Girl with the Ugly Name, and Other Stories."
Titled "The Fleeing Pancake", this collection of silly folk tales is suitable for small children.

bat.name: Bat
bat.desc: Aggressive little bats living in the dark

cbat.name: Cave bat
cbat.desc: Large, agile bats that swooop down to strike from the air

stirge.name: Stirge
stirge.desc: Giant vampire bats rumored to drain a victim's life in a single blow

spd1.name: Attic spider
spd1.desc: Small docile spiders who live in damp and dark places

doll.name: Doll
doll.desc: Child's toy possessed by an evil spirit

ndoll.name: Necro doll
ndoll.desc: Evil Dolls used in dark rituals

cdoll.name: Quicksilver
cdoll.desc: Dolls possessed by the souls of children who lost their lives to war or illness

zomb1.name: Zombie
zomb1.desc: Once the inhabitants of the surface, zombies emerge from the Dark to attack the living

mumy.name: Mummy
mumy.desc: Ancient corpses infused with the power of Dark

ghl.name: Ghoul
ghl.desc: Ghouls lurk in the Catacombs, longing for human flesh. Attacking their heads proves effective

ght.name: Ghast
ght.desc: The living dead, given power by demons of the Underworld

zmbf.name: Zombie Fighter
zmbf.desc: Corpses of common soldiers, brought back to life through the Dark's taint

zmbk.name: Zombie Knight
zmbk.desc: Zombies of the Knights of the Cross, still in possession of potent martial skills

zmbm.name: Zombie Mage
zmbm.desc: Zombies of Dark mages, who employ powerful offensive magic

skl.name: Skeleton
skl.desc: Skeletal remains of zombie corpses. They lurk in darkness to attack the living

slm1.name: Blue Slime
slm1.desc: Lesser slimes, devoid of any senses. They survive by absorbing debris from the ground

slm2.name: Green Slime
slm2.desc: Small forest slimes. They hide in leaves and grass

rbt1.name: Wild Rabbit
rbt1.desc: Docile rabbits, often found in plains and woods. They're difficult to catch

slm3.name: Cyan Slime
slm3.desc: Brightly colored slime. It looks like it can perfectly reflect the sky

slm4.name: Clear Slime
slm4.desc: Weird transparent slime, bearing no distinct color. They can hide anywhere and are very difficult to notice

kksh.name: Scarecrow
kksh.desc: Once protector of fields, this figure has turned to evil by the influence of Dark. It hangs still in ambush, waiting for unsuspecting passersby

golem1.name: Straw Golem
golem1.desc: Big golem composed of straw. These golems are brittle and weak, their main purpose is to assist newbies in training

golem2.name: Reinforced Straw Golem
golem2.desc: This golem's joints have been binded by the rope, giving it sturdier and more stable frame

golem3.name: Paper Golem
golem3.desc: Slim golem made of paper-like material. While not as tough as other training golems, it has a light body which allows it to move faster

golem4.name: Attack Golem
golem4.desc: Golem with implanted martial prowess. Somewhat similar to a trained militant, they pose a dangerous threat to any unprepared opponent

lrck.name: Locked Rock
lrck.desc: A rock shaped monster found in caves and dungeons. It has a habit of closing of paths by mimicking a wall, but it's fighting prowess is close to zero.

lsprt.name: Lamp Spirit
lsprt.desc: Small fire sprites that manifest inside oil lamps located in mines and other places with low human activity. While not sinister by nature, they enjoy playing pranks on people

dcrps1.name: Disaster Corpse
dcrps1.desc: Undead bodies manifested purely by death ki. They appear in ancient battlefields or other areas with extremely heavy concentration of dark ki. These corpses share countless memories of residue souls

unsctn.name: Unchanging Skeleton
unsctn.desc: People that neither die nor dissolve, active in the world but don't have minds or memories. They won't hurt people other than pulling pranks and causing trouble, but would go frenzy if exposed to death ki for too long

wolf1.name: Weakened Wolf
wolf1.desc: Wolves affected by a disease or other negative influences. While not nearly as dangerous as its healthy counterpart, even in such a low state they pose danger to those who aren't careful

slm5.name: Blue Slime
slm5.desc: Slime of a very deep darkblue hue, which looks shiny under the light and almost completely dark in the shade

test1.name: Beast killer
test1.desc: Attacks against beast type creatures are 30% more effective

psnwrd.name: Poison block
psnwrd.desc: Weak poisons have no effect on you

psnwrd2.name: Venom block
psnwrd2.desc: Severe poisons have no effect on you

fplc.name: Fireplace Aura
fplc.desc: You're feeling the warmth of the fireplace

cdlt.name: Candlelight
cdlt.desc: You're carrying a candle. The surroundings are lit up

fbite.name: Hypothermia
fbite.desc: Your limbs are suffering from frostbites

amsk.name: Wolf Mask
amsk.desc:
A cute wolf mask.
It symbolizes Fire

bmsk.name: Frog Mask
bmsk.desc:
A cute frog mask.
It symbolizes Water

cmsk.name: Cat Mask
cmsk.desc:
A cute cat mask.
It symbolizes Wind

dmsk.name: Dog Mask
dmsk.desc:
A cute dog mask.
It symbolizes Bravery

plt.name: Pelta Shield
plt.desc: Triangular shield composed of several layers of wood banded together, making it a little on the heavy side

mstn.name: Mana Stone
mstn.desc: Gem imbued with raw arcanic power

bstn.name: Blood Stone
bstn.desc: Gem imbued with the power of blood

sstn.name: Soul Stone
sstn.desc: Gem with a fraction of a soul trapped inside of it

srng.name: Silver Ring
srng.desc: Simple ring made of silver. It is used as a base for making enchanted accessories

grng.name: Gold Ring
grng.desc: Valuable ring made of gold. Has high vanity value and can be improved by setting gems into it

trrng.name: Trinity
trrng.desc: Rings were given to the Knights in ancient times, as a symbol of loyalty. Strenghtens mind and body

gmph1.name: Titan Malachite
gmph1.desc: Malachite with a Titan's soul bound inside. Slightly increases the power of direct attacks

gmph2.name: Talos Feldspar
gmph2.desc: Feldspar imbued with the dark powers of Talos. Increases the power of direct attacks

gmai1.name: Sylphid Topaz
gmai1.desc: Topaz imbued with the power of the Sylphs. Slightly increases air affinity

gmai2.name: Djinn Amber
gmai2.desc: Amber imbued with the power of Sylphs. Increases air affinity

gmfr1.name: Salamander Ruby
gmfr1.desc: Ruby imbued with the power of the Salamanders. Slightly increases fire affinity

gmfr2.name: Ifrit Carnelian
gmfr2.desc: Carnelian imbued with the power of Ifrit. Increases fire affinity

gmea1.name: Gnome Emerald
gmea1.desc: Emerald imbued with the power of the Gnomes. Slightly increases earth affinity

gmea2.name: Dao Moonstone
gmea2.desc: Moonstone imbued with the power of Dao. Increases earth affinity

gmwt1.name: Undine Jasper
gmwt1.desc: Jasper imbued with the power of the Undines. Slightly increases water affinity

gmwt2.name: Marid Aquamarine
gmwt2.desc: Aquamarine imbued with the power of Marid. Increases water affinity

gmhl1.name: Angel Pearl
gmhl1.desc: Pearl imbued with the power of the angels. Slightly increases light affinity

gmhl2.name: Seraphim Diamond
gmhl2.desc: Diamond with a seraph's soul bound inside. Increases light affinity

gmdk1.name: Morlock Jet
gmdk1.desc: Jet stone sealed with Morlock's magical power. Slightly increases dark affinity

gmdk2.name: Berial Blackpearl
gmdk2.desc: Blackpearl with Berial's soul bound inside. Increases dark affinity

rngsgn.name: Signet Ring
rngsgn.desc: A gold and silver ring with a wide stamp attached to the band. A long time ago, the stamp was legible, but now the pattern is too worn to discern its former use

frplc.name: Fireplace
frplc.desc: Comfy fireplace. You can light it up for various useful means, or just to warm up

bed1.name: Straw Bedding
bed1.desc: A "bed" made from several layers of straw placed onto each other. Extremely itchy and isn't much better from sleeping on a rock

bed2.name: Plain Bed
bed2.desc: Crude planks cobbled together to form a container for a matress or such. Not a whole lot in terms of sleeping place, but somewhat better than a hard cold floor

tbwr2.name: Clay Tableware
tbwr2.desc: Tableware made from hardened clay. Easy to make and doesn't cost very much

tbwr3.name: Ceramic Tableware
tbwr3.desc: Quality and shiny ceramic tableware. Though it is commonly available and not expensive, some prefer to display it on the shelves for decorative purposes

wvbkt.name: Straw Basket
wvbkt.desc: Small woven basket. For storing stuff in

strgbx.name: Storage Box
strgbx.desc: Huge container with a secure padlock. You can put your possessions inside to keep them safe.

rcs.name: Reality shot
rcs.desc: Amplifies surrounding awareness and perception senses

cndl.name: Candle
cndl.desc: A tall wax candle, made to burn for a very long time

feip1.name: Fei Pill
feip1.desc: When an alchemist miserably fails to produce a pill, this waste is created. Compound of ruined medical materials is full of poison and impurities, it can be used to kill those with weak constitution. However, it is not useless, and can be absorbed for raw ki if one endures the pain and survives after consuming it

bmsmktt.name: Smoke Pellet Cluster
bmsmktt.desc: Repurposed smoke bomb, made by concentrating multiple volatile components together, making the moke several times more hazardous, but not enough to cause real damage to a living person. Since the ignition period from such a modification is much longer, it has fewer uses than a regular smoke bomb

death_b.name: Death Badge
death_b.desc: Awarded by fate for dying. Congratulations

sstraw.name: Strand Of Straw
sstraw.desc: This fell out of a dummy when you punched it to death

cp.name: Penny
cp.desc: A single penny, outdated form of currency. For some reason it's still in circulation

lcn.name: Large Copper Coin
lcn.desc: Local currency in a form of a heavy coin. Poor people can eat for a whole day with a few of those

cn.name: Nickel
cn.desc: Small nickel, outdated form of currency. It was worth much more in the past

cq.name: Quarter
cq.desc: Very large coin, made of copper. Not much worth as money, but collected and used by poor blacksmiths for resmelting into tools

psb.name: Pleasant Sleep Blanket
psb.desc: Soft warm blanket. It makes you sleep better

wdc.name: Wood Splint
wdc.desc: A small chipped piece of wood. Not very useful by itself

bgl.name: Bag of lost items
bgl.desc: Lost possession of waifarers and travellers

salt.name: Salt
salt.desc: Rock salt crushed into tiny crystals. Yuck! You surely wouldn't want to eat this. It's good for preserving perishable foods and cooking, though

slm.name: Slime
slm.desc: Clear blob of slime. Used in elementary alchemy to make adhesives. Also acts as a base for some potions

tlvs.name: Tea leaves
tlvs.desc: A pinch of fragnant tea leaves, ready for brewing

hnhn.name: Teruterubōzu
hnhn.desc: Holy talisman. Leave it out on the rain to gain blessing of good fortune

pcn.name: Pinecone
pcn.desc: A spiny pod from a pine tree.  Dry seeds rattle around inside when you shake it

ptng1.name: Tattered Painting
ptng1.desc: Scratched up and faded painting of a lady. It's nearly impossible to recognize any details

fwd1.name: Firewood
fwd1.desc: Type of dry wood, prepared for easy burning. Useful at camps or during winter

coal1.name: Coal
coal1.desc: Black rocks of fossilized organic mass. This coal burns for a very long time

coal2.name: Charcoal
coal2.desc: Coal made from carefuly burning quality wood for lengths of time. This coal cinders for a very long time

skl.name: Skull
skl.desc: Mostly undamaged human skull, taken from some unlucky corpse. It is used in various ways by all sorts of dark sorcerers, witches and alchemists

rope.name: Rope
rope.desc: A length of sturdy rope, for tying things up

stdst.name: Stardust
stdst.desc: Tiny bits of solar pieces that came from the Sky. They shine in darkness and hold the energy of stars

gcre1.name: Lesser Golem Core
gcre1.desc: Exhausted power core of a golem. It has nearly no use anymore, the entire energy supply of this thing has been used up

ess1.name: Essence of Air
ess1.desc: Spirit shard of concentrated Wind power

ess2.name: Essence of Earth
ess2.desc: Spirit shard of concentrated Geo power

ess3.name: Essence of Flames
ess3.desc: Spirit shard of concentrated Fire power

ess4.name: Essence of Water
ess4.desc: Spirit shard of concentrated Aqua power

ess5.name: Essence of Light
ess5.desc: Spirit shard of concentrated Holy power

ess6.name: Essence of Night
ess6.desc: Spirit shard of concentrated Demonic power

cpdst.name: Corpse Dust
cpdst.desc: Dust derived from the remains of the deciesed, often used for witchcraft and enchantments

cclth.name: Cheap Cloth
cclth.desc: A poor quality swatch of cloth. Unstitches when you so much as breathe on it

thrdnl.name: Thread
thrdnl.desc: A small quantity of thread that could be used in sewing and tailoring projects

sktbad.name: Mistake
sktbad.desc: A failed product of an unskilled artisan. Once destined to become something worty of display, this mangled mess is repulsive to look at

dfish.name: Dead Fish
dfish.desc: Carcass of some fish, looking bad, grey and dead. Can be dismantled into fishbait

fbait1.name: Bait
fbait1.desc: Organic remains rolled into a ball, favoured by fish and other aquatic population

htrdvr.name: Hunter's Crate
htrdvr.desc: Heavy wooden crate you were asked to deliver to dojo. It is sealed shut and you can't look inside. It smells faintly of meat, spices and mushrooms. Probably filled with preserved dry produce

htrsvr.name: Hunter's Bag
htrsvr.desc: Heavy canvas bag you were asked to deliver to the herbalist. It is filled with separated bundles of various herbs you can't identify. You'd rather not touch anything inside as it looks dangerously poisonous

hbtsvr.name: Herbalist's Satchel
hbtsvr.desc: Heavy leather satchel you were asked to deliver to the head hunter. Hundreds of vials clang Violently no matter how carefully you attempt to carry it

fwdpile.name: Firewood Pile
fwdpile.desc: Stockpile of firewood neatly packed together for easy storage

lprmt.name: Travel Permit
lprmt.desc: Written document used in your village. Acts as a proof of one's strength, meaning the owner has the ability to protect himself when leaving the village, you will need this when going out. Nearly every adult you know has this

wfng.name: Wolf Fang
wfng.desc: Clear and sharp fang of a predator. It still looks dangerous

dmice1.name: Dead Mouse
dmice1.desc: Vermin hunted by your cat, now proudly displayed before you

dbdc1.name: Dead Bird
dbdc1.desc: A proof of loyalty brought to you by your cat

ip1.name: "Idea paper"
ip1.desc: Tiny scrap of paper with information. You wrote it yourself to remember things.

tbrwdb.name: "The Art of Teabrewing"
tbrwdb.desc: Informative little book in detail describing the ways of teamaking, starting from precise amounts and proportions, specific water temperatures, correct tableware, to the defferent styles and etiquette

bcpn.name: "Cooking with Poison"
bcpn.desc: A leatherbound book with an embossed cauldron on the cover. Inside it describes ways to purify food through alchemy

mdc1.name: "First Aid Manual"
mdc1.desc: Tiny red pocket-sized guide to emergency care, covers basic bandaging and wound treating

dmkbk.name: "Dollmaker's Handbook"
dmkbk.desc: A very short manual filled with illustrations about primitive dollmaking. The instructions are easy to understand so children could make the dolls too. Looks like there was a chapter dedicated to sewing, now it's almost entirely missing

scrlw.name: "Ragged Parchment"
scrlw.desc: Scummy sheet of paper tainted with something teal. Some kinds of materials are listed here

wp2s.name: "Rotten Illustration"
wp2s.desc: Found this within old bushery, it looks like a drawing of something in charcoal

shppmf.name: "Pamphlet"
shppmf.desc: This was shoved onto you by someone on the streets. Store names, discount prices, hot items... An entire wall of advertisements in tiny letters, to fit as much of it as possible on this piece of paper. It is a good idea to memorize the addresses

amrthsck.name: "Guide To Living By Yourself"
amrthsck.desc: Looks like a page from someone's notebook, marked "H", poorly written in bad handwriting. It lists several simple things you can cook and make from widely available cheap materials

brdbn.name: "Your First Bread"
brdbn.desc: Very primitive instruction booklet about making simple breads. The way it's written, it looks very similar to manuals given to slaves and servants at the beginning of their service, if they are able to read

bfsnwt.name: "Beggar Fashion"
bfsnwt.desc: Some nonsence illustration with a name, featuring a group of peasants in rags posing awkwardly. What even is this?

fwd1.name: Firewood Gathering
fwd1.desc: Secure 10 bundles of firewood for hunter Yamato

hnt1.name: First Hunt
hnt1.desc: Hunt for 10 peices of meat for hunter Yamato

grds1.name: Guarding Duty
grds1.desc: You were tasked with guarding duty to watch over marketplace

lmfstkil1.name: Monster Eradication
lmfstkil1.desc: Dangerous monsters have invaded the southern forest and terrorizing the villagers. Get rid of them!

stfc.name: Staff M
stfc.desc: Ability to fight using staves and wands

alch.name: Alchemy
alch.desc: Knowledge of medicine and alchemical transmutation

bwc.name: Ranged M
bwc.desc: Ability to utilize bows and crossbows in combat

hvt.name: Foraging
hvt.desc: Ability to harvest gifts of Nature

glg.name: Geology
glg.desc: Knowledge and ability to identify precious minerals

mng.name: Mining
mng.desc: Ability to extract materials from stones and mountains

rccln.name: Temperance
rccln.desc: Ability to resist temptation of worldly possessions

swm.name: Swimming
swm.desc: Ability to dive and traverse waters

drka.name: Drinking
drka.desc: Ability to tolerate and enjoy alcoholic beverages

ptnc.name: Patience
ptnc.desc: Ability to endure forms of suffering without complaint

scout.name: Perception
scout.desc: Ability to see the unseen and better understand your surroundings

tlrng.name: Tailoring
tlrng.desc: Abillity to sew and create produce out of cloth

new.name: Nobody
new.desc: Unremarkable someone trying to find his purpose in life

inn.name: Initiate
inn.desc: Dojo disciple who managed to finish the first training stages. Woo!

thr.name: Thrasher
thr.desc: The one who destroyed dojo's precious equipment. Were you a bit older you'd pay the expences, but you made your teacher proud.

wsl.name: Wolf Slayer
wsl.desc: You went alone against a pack of feral wolves. That amounts to something!

knf.name: Butterfly
knf.desc: You always thought knives were cool. You aren't nearly precise with your knifework yet, But you will learn

bll.name: Bully
bll.desc: You have graduated from being a mere Weakling. You feel powerful! You still find it difficult to stand your own in a fight

cvl.name: Civilian
cvl.desc: You're not very suitable for combat. But you think you're out of options

stk.name: Stick Kid
stk.desc: You always liked swinging that thing around. You think you're beginning to understand how to land hits properly. Or not

fgt.name: Fighter
fgt.desc: You begin to start liking to fight! At the very least you can now somewhat defend yourself against mild threats and not just die in one hit

pbg.name: Weakling
pbg.desc: You can't really hit anything with these frail arms of yours

brw.name: Brawler
brw.desc: You feel like you can pack a punch! And recieve one. You're starting to feel a bit more comfortable with your bare fists

stb.name: Stabber
stb.desc: Even if it's a smaller tool compared to any other weapon, you've learned how to make knives useful for self-defence, since they are somewhat easier to handle than the rest. You can hit vitals better too

slp1.name: Sleeper
slp1.desc: You really like sleeping don't you? You spend a lot of time in your bed

slp2.name: Heavy Sleeper
slp2.desc: You learned to sleep very soundly, without any care for the outside world. Your body begins to adapt and grow stronger with every break you take

tcvl.name: Trained Civilian
tcvl.desc: You're still nearly useless in a real fight, but you have learned to at least move out of the way of danger

plm.name: Prick
plm.desc: You found it fun to make little holes in plant leaves and look through them at the Sun. You think this could be morbidly useful in a fight

wlk.name: Walker
wlk.desc: All this walking around feels very beneficial for your body

eat1.name: Starving Child
eat1.desc: You've been all skin and bones as long as you can remember. You will need to start eating properly if you wish to survive

eat2.name: Hungry Child
eat2.desc: You begin to gain some weight eating all this boring and dry food. But you're not complaining, at least you live

eat4.name: Satiated
eat4.desc: Being full is good, but you start to wonder what kinds of different dishes exist in the world

eat5.name: Mini-Gourmand
eat5.desc: You begin to understand the importance of tasty food! You crave the larger variety

cck.name: Campfire Cook
cck.desc: Not something to brag about, but you won't completely starve to death if you find yourself in the wilds without a proper meal

rok.name: Rookie
rok.desc: A novice fighter. You have a knack for martial arts but it doesn't amount to much yet

rnr.name: Runner
rnr.desc: Your body is in much better shape, so is your stamina. Moving around fast doesn't bother you as much anymore, but you spend your energy and get kind of hungry from it

jgg.name: Jogger
jgg.desc: Simply walking doesn't cut it anymore, maybe you should speed up a bit while travelling on foot?

ilt.name: Illiterate
ilt.desc: You have a really difficult time understanding even the basic writings. Even the signs outside the shops give you trouble

und.name: Uneducated
und.desc: You are not very friendly with books, your entire literature knowledge is nothing but simple kiddie stories and fairy tales

aaa.name: aaa
aaa.desc: They say that in the hands of a gosu with great inner ki, even a dead leaf can become a weapon that can pierce iron plates

eat3.name: Malnourished
eat3.desc: You are clearly undereating, yet, eating something other than bland untasty bread leaves you in a positive mood

srd1.name: Aspiring Ronin
srd1.desc: Watching swordplay of elder swordmasters always fascinated you, yet even trying to hold the sword properly is apparently extremely difficult. You are not the type to give up though

srd2.name: Sword Trainee
srd2.desc: You have only just began learning the Way of the Sword, which clearly shows. You still find it hard to wield the sword properly, let alone attempting to hit something with it

srd3.name: Squire
srd3.desc: All those thousand swings training sessions weren't for nothing. Now you can hold your sword somewhat straight and your posture got better. Hovewer, slashing things didn't get any easier

srd4.name: Blade for Hire
srd4.desc: Your swordplay has reached the rank of a common foot soldier. Or so you thought. Maybe you can match a lowest level mercenary, which isn't something to be proud of. You are still ways away from calling yourself a proper swordsman

lnc1.name: Spearholder
lnc1.desc: You have learned how the art of Spearmanship can be used for both offensive and defensive combat, which you think suits you pretty well. Hovewer, handling a spear with skill is much more difficult than you initially thought

lnc2.name: Village Militia
lnc2.desc: Your reflexes wielding a polearm got slightly better, at the very least you aren't dropping your weapon after every second swing anymore. You could be considered a part of a peasant spear group with your measly skills

lnc3.name: Phlanger
lnc3.desc: You're getting a hold of your primitive spearmanship, which is reasurring considering how much effort went into your training. You could be a part of the second-rate frontline military squad with your ability, but you will aim higher

hmr2.name: Basher
hmr2.desc: Squashing things with a hammer or a club may seem simple, but it does require some skill to do so properly and effectively. You understand the basics but lack the strength for it, though

hmr3.name: Heavy Hand
hmr3.desc: You favor strong blunt weaponry, which shows by how sturdy and hard your hands have become. This is good for your overall strength. You still lack any skill or technique, hovewer

kill1.name: Pest Control
kill1.desc: You have wiped out about 10000 creatures on your way. Most of them weren't living things though... right?

rspn1.name: Punching Bag
rspn1.desc: Getting beat up like this hurts like hell. You better think of a way out of this misery!

rfpn1.name: Garbage Eater
rfpn1.desc: All the time you had to consume disgusting rotten stuff is finally paying off... Kind of. You would rather avoid doing that in the future, if possible

rfpn2.name: Iron Stomach
rfpn2.desc: Going through these desperate times of having such an unsafe diet, your stomach doesn't feel as awful anymore. You really shouldn't be doing that

rfpn3.name: Omnivore
rfpn3.desc: It seems like you can eat a lot of awful stuff and feel fine afterwards. Is that really worth it? You think it is. The taste doesn't get any better though...

tqtm.name: Quartermaster
tqtm.desc: You have returned more than 300 pieces of dojo supplies. How much of that stuff do they have?

ddw.name: Glass Bones
ddw.desc: Bizzarely, you got yourself knocked out by the weakest enemy in existence. How did that happen? You feel like you have achieved somewhat absurd understanding of how frail your body actually is. Perhaps violence isn't for you

neet.name: Hikikomori
neet.desc: You have spent an entire year at your house without going out even once. You were somewhat productive in your seclusion, but the time spent didn't even feel like a year, however...

aptc.name: Apprentice
aptc.desc: You have succesfully completed the second part of dojo's training courses. You are impressed by your own achievements!

sld1.name: Wimp
sld1.desc: The fear of pain has forced you to begin taking cover behind whatever you take your hands on. Shields fall within this category nicely, you think you should try learning how to handle them properly

sld2.name: Defender
sld2.desc: Even if you're still full of openings and have a terrible time adjusting to the weight of a shield you're holding, you can still manage to reflect the slowest, stupidest and the most direct attack you're facing. Sometimes

sld3.name: Protector
sld3.desc: You understand better how shields work, and your reaction time against frontal attacks has improved as well. Your openings are still plentiful, but you manage to stay alive

seye1.name: Bat Eyes
seye1.desc: Sometimes when you hit an enemy the certain way your attack feels somewhat stronger, you noticed. What's that about?

seye2.name: Suspicious Eyes
seye2.desc: You have confirmed it, bashing the enemy on the head makes your battles end slightly quicker. Is it only the head that does that?

pet1.name: Valley Cat
pet1.desc: Stray animals don't seem to be wary of you that much, for some reason. You are able to hug a random cat without it running away

pet2.name: Animal Friend
pet2.desc: Minor predators don't view you as a threat, which is good, but you don't want to bother them when they're hungry, though. You think you have a way to avoid the dangers of wild life, at least

dngs1.name: Wary
dngs1.desc: Sometimes when you're hit it hurts much more then usual. You hate this, but why does that happen? You have to figure out how to avoid this

dngs2.name: Careful
dngs2.desc: Avoiding hits to the vitals is much harder, as you found out. You must think of a way to take precautions to guarantee your own safety

rtr1.name: Coward
rtr1.desc: You can't stomach the thought of getting seriously injured at all. Running away from danger is where it's at

neet2.name: Shut In
neet2.desc: Staying home for a year was nothing, this time you went half a decade staying put in your comfortable living space, caring not for the outside world. You are not sure how you feel about nobody ever checking on you..

neet3.name: Hermit
neet3.desc: Tenth of century at home, you did it. What were you even doing in there? Sleeping? Cultivating? It doesn't matter, you can proudly call yourself a hermit and stay forgotten until you decide to show yourself in light again

coo1.name: Kitchen Nightmare
coo1.desc: Either cooking is a very difficult art, or you're just very bad at it. Leaving you alone in the kitchen is a recipe for disaster. But you won't become good without making some mistakes first

kill2.name: Sweeper
kill2.desc: Eliminating 50000 creatures like it was nothing made you wonder whether this realm is filled with weaklings or it is you who are simply too strong to handle. It is probably the former

kill3.name: Bone Collector
kill3.desc: Hack and slash! 200000 foes have fallen under mighty arm! You're getting a little too comfortable on your path of destruction

kill5.name: Sentinel
kill5.desc: 5 million deaths! You managed to undo the population of the small city. That's quiet a feat given your low power level

axc1.name: Hack
axc1.desc: Axes are difficult to handle, you learned. This isn't simply chpping firewood on a log, you a need hard grip and proper hand flexibility to fight with them efficiently

axc2.name: Chopper
axc2.desc: You feel strong when using axes in battles! You only feel that way, you are not any strong with it yet. It is difficut for you to find the right balance to swing that thing

dth1.name: Fallen
dth1.desc: Somehow you always escape life threatening situations even after being hit and bruised a lot, hovewer you still lose conciousness. Newbie's luck?

dth2.name: Decadent
dth2.desc: Often you manage to avoid death even after being heavily injured. Perhaps you have a very resilient body, or Heavens aren't willing to accept you yet

seye3.name: Dissector
seye3.desc: By slaying foes as much as you did, you learned how to quickly notice your enemies' weak points. This knowledge will allow you quickly and effectively dispose of those standing in your way

fmn1.name: Scrawny
fmn1.desc: You feel terrible. You might want to eat something or you'll end up being nothing more than a skeleton

fmn2.name: Bag Of Bones
fmn2.desc: Days of hunger took a toll on your body, yet made you learn to conserve your energy by other means, which shows. Just a bit

fmn3.name: Emaciated
fmn3.desc: Yesterdays's weakness is today's strength. Or so you've heard. You are not feeling as awful and weak by starving yourself, but there's still nothing to be proud of

shpt1.name: Third-Rate Shopper
shpt1.desc: You left the shop with half a thousand goods total. It's a tiny amount if you think about it - food, cooking ingredients, household tools

mone1.name: Beggar
mone1.desc: Acquiring a whole 1 Gold coin worth of money is a lot for someone as pathetic you. You could survive with that amount for a year!

ttsttl1.name: Unknown
ttsttl1.desc: You barely took a single minor step into the world by gathering 10 titles. Nobody takes notice of you or your ambition, you are but a filler existence that doesn't amount to anything yet

ttsttl2.name: Nameless
ttsttl2.desc: 25 titles would be something an average working man would aquire effortlessly by simply living his life. You shouldn't feel proud by only reaching this high

ttsttl3.name: Ordinary
ttsttl3.desc: You're finally getting somewhere, having a basic set of skills and minor achievements. You could even be called reliable by some. But once again, you are feeling like a part of the mass

hstr1.name: Pathetic
hstr1.desc: Your weak punch can barely exert a power of 100kg, which is a measly amount in the martial world. A simple farmer can hit harder than this

hstr2.name: Softhitter
hstr2.desc: You got somewhat stronger in reaching 250kg worth of punch power. You can manage some physical labor with that strength, but nothing noteworthy

hstr3.name: Jawbreaker
hstr3.desc: Half ton punch isn't bad, you can successfully push a body a few meters back if you hit correctly in the right spot. This only applies to entities without strong physical protection, you are no match to anything with real strength

pet3.name: Wild Kid
pet3.desc: All that time you spent with your cat made you understand a whole lot about the habits and behaviour of vicious predators. You feel that knowledge might prove to be useful one day

ndthextr.name: Safehouse
ndthextr.desc: You kept yourself well and protected, avoiding danger and moving out of harm's way for quiet some time. Almost like any other person who fears for his life

dialogue.grab_your_stuff_and_get_to_it_30c7a736: ???: Grab your stuff and get to it
dialogue.instructor_you_got_beaten_up_by_an_inani: "Instructor: You got beaten up by an inanimated dummy?! Pay attention to your condition!"
dialogue.instructor_your_training_is_over_for_tod: "Instructor: Your training is over for today, you did well. As a reward, select one of these skill manuals to practice. The better your understanding, the stronger you will be in battle"
dialogue.instructor_hahahhha_what_a_great_discipl: "Instructor: Hahahhha! What a great disciple! That's not the dedication most of the other disciples have! Take this, it'll help you in your future endeavours"
dialogue.instructor_you_can_return_whatever_you_p: "Instructor: You can return whatever you punched off of dummies and get coin for it, it's dojo's equipment after all. Or you can keep and use for it yourself, the choice is yours"
dialogue.instructor_there_s_nothing_i_can_take_fr: "Instructor: There's nothing I can take from you"
dialogue.instructor_if_you_put_effort_into_traini: "Instructor: If you put effort into training you will get rewards as long as you are still a disciple of this hall. After every 5 levels you reach, come here and recieve your share! You might get something really useful if you continue to improve your skills"
dialogue.instructor_this_is_a_good_start_congratu: "Instructor: This is a good start, congratulations! Keep working hard!"
dialogue.instructor_you_seem_to_not_neglect_your_: "Instructor: You seem to not neglect your training, good job! Keep working hard!"
dialogue.instructor_you_re_slowly_growing_into_a_: "Instructor: You're slowly growing into a fine young warrior! Keep working hard!"
dialogue.instructor_time_to_start_getting_serious: "Instructor: Time to start getting serious! Keep working hard!"
dialogue.instructor_you_re_almost_ready_to_face_r: "Instructor: You're almost ready to face real dangers of the outside world! Keep working hard!"
dialogue.instructor_you_are_almost_as_strong_as_a: "Instructor: You are almost as strong as an average adult! Good job kid and Keep working hard! Maybe you can defend this village one day"
dialogue.instructor_yamato_sent_something_great_t: "Instructor: Yamato sent something? Great timing on that, we were getting very close to running out already. This will be turned into rations for you lads, you better don't forget to thank our hunters properly next time you see them, as they work hard to bring food to people's tables. Here, small compensation for your timely delivery"
dialogue.instructor_hold_it_that_s_not_all_catch_: "Instructor: Hold it, that's not all, catch this as well, i believe it is yours. You won't be as lucky next time and lose your possessions for good if you leave them around again, pay better attention to where your stuff is"
dialogue.instructor_once_again_choose_the_skillbo: "Instructor: Once again, choose the skillbook of specialization you are interested in. Doesn't mean you have to stick with it to the bitter end, but it will help you train"
dialogue.useful_information_regarding_dojo_is_wri: Useful information regarding dojo is written here. What will you read?
dialogue.fight_dummies_provided_by_dojo_to_improv: Fight dummies provided by dojo to improve your physique and weapon skills! Destroy them and grab their stuff, or vanquish thousands for a special reward! The doors of our dojo is open for everyone willing to lead the path of a warrior
dialogue.when_you_are_confident_in_your_skills_tr: When you are confident in your skills, try your fist at fighting powerful golems! How much beating can you withstand?
dialogue.as_long_as_you_keep_gaining_experience_a: As long as you keep gaining experience and train hard, dojo will provide you with gifts and money! Don't miss out!
dialogue.instructor_great_job_smashing_that_golem: Instructor: Great job smashing that golem! This golem is one of the weakest types around, but even he can become a huge trouble if you're not giving it your best. Now, grab this and proceed with your training
dialogue.instructor_just_like_that_keep_it_up_you: Instructor: Just like that, keep it up. You are starting to stand much longer in fights, such an improvement from when you just arrived here! You deserver your praise, but don't get complacent
dialogue.instructor_that_was_a_tough_one_but_you_: Instructor: That was a tough one, but you still managed to crush it! You are getting close to finishing a second course. Don't give up!
dialogue.instructor_as_expected_you_have_what_it_: Instructor: As expected, you have what it takes to protect yourself! And with that, you have finished the second entry course of this dojo, job well done! Soon, you will be able to step out of the village and take on serious jobs that will let you explore the land. You better prepare yourself well before that happens!
dialogue.punch_as_many_as_you_want_aff9824a: Punch as many as you want
dialogue.you_re_out_in_the_forest_you_can_4c0bd70: You're out in the forest. You can hunt here
dialogue.you_never_knew_this_secluded_area_was_he: You never knew this secluded area was here
dialogue.you_see_something_sticking_out_from_the_: You see something sticking out from the ground in the grass over there. Bones?
dialogue.indeed_bones_skeletal_remains_of_a_perso: Indeed, bones. Skeletal remains of a person to be exact. Looks like he died long time ago, much of everything rotted off, even metallic bits of whatever armor he was wearing have fallen apart.
dialogue.there_isn_t_much_you_can_take_with_5d1a1: There isn't much you can take with you, except for the sword on the skeleton's hip, still inside its half-desintegrated sheath. What was the cause of his death? He wasn't in a fight judging by the state of the sword. Was he poisoned? Or caught by surprise? Couldn't leave this place for whatever reason? You are not sure. The least you can do is honor the deceased by burying his remains
dialogue.your_good_deed_improved_your_karma_28bfe: Your good deed improved your karma!
dialogue.you_discover_a_pouch_half_etched_into_th: You discover a pouch half-etched into the ground and covered by a rock. It probably belonged to the corpse
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_you_why_do_you_have_4: Head Hunter Yamato: You! Why do you have that?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_the_sword_where_did_y: Head Hunter Yamato: The sword! Where did you get it!?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_the_body_in_the_fores: Head Hunter Yamato: The body in the forest, you say... Dammit! Our scouts are worthless if it takes someone like you to make such an important discovery! *sigh..* This sword you're holding once belonged to our deputy chief - Dein. You might have not met him before if you never set your foot out of the village, he was a promising and talented young soldier who were assigned to such an remote settlement for his field training
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_then_one_day_he_staig: Head Hunter Yamato: Then one day he staight up vanished, without letting anyone know, and he was well respected and cared for our people all the same. Of course, being a part of the military would prevent him from disclosing his plans and duties, but it is highly doubtful a special task from the higher command would be the reason of his abscence. All of his belongins, personal items and possessions are still there, where he left them. Lad knew how to fight and wield a sword, I do not for once believe a man of his caliber would perish and die like this, the corpse you speak of might not be his...
dialogue.express_your_condolences_to_the_deceased: Express your condolences to the deceased
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_alright_enough_your_s: Head Hunter Yamato: Alright, enough. Your sentiment is appreciated, but let us hope Dein still draws breath out there. This entire precident calls for investigation, a team of hunters will be dispatched shortly and you keep yourself alert too. And I will be taking that from your hands, thank you for bringing it here. Time will tell wether this sword becomes a memento or returns to its rightful owner
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_here_take_this_for_yo: Head Hunter Yamato: Here, take this for your trouble
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_hm_your_face_is_unfam: Head Hunter Yamato: Hm? Your face is unfamiliar. Might be your first time around here I take it? These are the Western Woods, or simply the western part of the forest. Spots here are very meek and mild on danger and resources, it is perfect for newbies like you. You are free to come and hunt as much as you like. Consider doing some of the available jobs while you're at it. Won't pay much, but you can be of help to the people.
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_delivery_back_that_s_:
Head Hunter Yamato: Delivery back? That's unexpected! Put this here, let me examine it... I see, we're going east soon, then... Well, that's not for you to worry about, hhah! There is another thing. You wait here a moment
.......

Heeere we go! Get this crate to the dojo since you're going in that direction anyway. They'll know what to do with it. Go now, go
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_one_more_thing_i_ll_f: Head Hunter Yamato: One more thing. I'll ask you to do this very easy, little job. Grab this bag and get it to the village's herbalist. You know where the herbalist is? Here are the directions, listen well: head to the marketplace and look for a very unremarkable little building with a sign that looks like a vial. Like those vials they use in alchemy, those ones. The building is located a little further back from the road, in the shade, so you may simply forget it exists if you aren't specifically looking for it, you keep your eyes peeled. Now go, you should have no problem getting there
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_what_do_you_want_to_9: Head Hunter Yamato: What do you want to ask, kid? Want to know how to butcher a carcass? Khahhahhah! *cough*
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_ranking_is_a_way_to_5:
Head Hunter Yamato: Ranking is a way to separate monsters by their relative danger level, they go as following:
G - Can be dealth with by able people
F - Can be dealth with by male adults
E - Village Crisis
D - Townside Crisis
C - Citywide Crisis
B - National Crisis
A - Continental Threat
S - Global Crisis
SS - World Disaster
SSS - Universal Calamity
We haven't experienced anything stronger than the E rank in all history of our village. Whatever is above the A rank is completely unheard of, and only partially mentioned in ancient texts. That's the realm of gods, world destroyers and higher beings that our mortal souls are unlikely to ever face
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_monsters_you_say_ther:
Head Hunter Yamato: Monsters, you say? There are many and they are around, terrorizing peaceful folk in the outside world. Our remote parts don't see much of that, these lands are tame. Not without dangers, of course, you meet a wild boar in the forest - a single wrong move and its tusks are in your guts and that is it, end of the fool. Or those pesky slimes, while don't look menacing and pose little danger, they sometimes gather and destroy the fields by melting crops and soil. We have it good but starvation is worse than any monster, at times. *cough* anyway, anything living and non-living you meet can be separated into 6 categories:
Human, Beast, Undead, Evil, Phantom, Dragon
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_humans_and_demihumans: Head Hunter Yamato: Humans and Demihumans fall into the same class. People like you and me, beastmen, orcs, goblins... Mostly creatures intelligent enough to walk on their two, use tools, form societies, make settlements, trade and speak on their own violition. You will encounter and perhaps fight them as bandits, criminals, members of the opposing factions and armies, whoever you disagree with. Always be on your guard, humanoids are cunning and skilled, versatile and very adaptive. Yet, they have mushy bodies. One correct strike and you get an advantage
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_beasts_are_your_usual: Head Hunter Yamato: Beasts are your usual, normal wildlife like wolves, slimes, mimics, or prone to being evil Demihumans with low intelligence and high level of aggression like ogres, harpies, minotaurs. While animals are dumb, never underestimate a wild beast. With their thick skin and natural weapons like fangs and claws, they pose a major threat when driven into a desperate state. Fire works very well against the most, especially those with fur and feathers, keep that in mind next time you go hunting
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_undead_as_you_could_a: Head Hunter Yamato: Undead, as you could already tell, are living dead. Reanimated remains of humans and beasts by the influence of natural forces or a skilled necromancer. Even if they completely lack intelligence and wander around aimlessly, controlled bodies of the dead get strenghtened by Dark magic and gain unnatural resilience and power as a result. It doesn't prevent them from being hurt by fire or Holy powers, hovewer. You can deal with lesser fragile skeletal beings quickly if you bash them with something blunt
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_beings_that_are_artif: Head Hunter Yamato: Beings that are artificially made or existences who are inherently evil, can be classified as such. Demons, imps, golems, possessed weapons and armor, gremlins, devils and much of anything else that comes out from the Underworld. They are extremely dangerous and seek destruction all that they come across
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_souls_of_the_dead_eth: Head Hunter Yamato: Souls of the dead, ethereal beings, manifestations of powers or other apparitions can all be called Phantoms. They take forms of wisp and sprites, benevolent or twisted elementals or spirits and wraiths that terrorize the living. They are difficult or sometimes outright impossible to hurt using normal physical means, magic or exorcism would be a preferred way of dealing with such enemies
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_dragons_are_legendary: Head Hunter Yamato: Dragons are legendary creatures that possess evil and cunning intellect. Through some unknown means many dragons in ancient times were reduced to subspecies of wyverns and wyrms, or outright bastard draconids like lizardmen, and other beings with Dragon bloodline. The power of said bloodline grants them superior defence against magic and energy abilities, their physical toughness is also no joke
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_i_ll_fetch_you_15_de0: Head Hunter Yamato: I'll fetch you 15 copper per bundle! How many do you want to sell?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_here_is_what_s_availa: Head Hunter Yamato: Here is what's available, take a look
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_don_t_even_think_abou: Head Hunter Yamato: Don't even think about it, you will not be sent to your death. Go back and train, dojo has everything you need
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_what_s_this_your_aura: Head Hunter Yamato: What's this? Your aura has changed since we last met! All the martial training you went through certainly hasn't gone to waste, this kid is definitely isn't a pushover anymore, hah! If you have the guts to take on the next task, listen well - southern forest is becoming more and more dangerous, lethal beasts keep crawling in from the farther plains, making it very difficult to do any sort of work in the south. Looks like wolves this time. Some fear, at this rate, they might reach and assault the village, and that will have need to be dealth with. This is a dangerous issue, and you will have to have courage to take it on, but in turn it will serve you as great real battle experience. Other lads have already signed up, as well. Are you willing?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_hunt_down_all_the_wol: Head Hunter Yamato: Hunt down all the wolves you find and return once you destroy at least 35 of them. You will also want this, every hunter should keep his personal notes close. And prepare medicinal bandages, just in case. Be careful, and good luck
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_having_troubles_with_: Head Hunter Yamato: Having troubles with the task?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_what_is_that_fire_in_: Head Hunter Yamato: What is that fire in your eyes? Can it be you are done already?
dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_that_isn_t_good_sound: Head Hunter Yamato: That isn't good, sounds like trouble... Might have been the leader of the pack, furious about death of his underlings. dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_while_coal_is_not_eas: Head Hunter Yamato: While coal is not easy to obtain around here, good burnable wood is always in demand. Your job this time is to collect and bring about 10 bundles of firewood, keep an eye out while you're strolling out in the forest. dialogue.head_hunter_yamato_very_good_you_didn_t_: Head Hunter Yamato: Very good, you didn't disappoint. You can never have enough burning material, be it for cooking or warmth, or anything else.
